preferred_levers.condition: Payment within 10 days in exchange for a cash discount

evidence.quote: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.
Several of our invoices are overdue again. We ask you to keep to the agreed payment terms; otherwise we will have to review our conditions.
he asked twice whether we could pay earlier and said the bank is watching every month.
I cannot sign anything that lowers our margin now.
